query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_assessments,
  ROUND(AVG(overall_confidence_score), 1) as avg_confidence,
  SUM(CASE WHEN overall_confidence_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as low_confidence_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_score >= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as high_fraud_risk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_score >= 40 AND fraud_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as medium_fraud_risk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fraud_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_fraud_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enriched_photos_json IS NOT NULL AND enriched_photos_json != '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_enriched_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN damage_photos_json IS NOT NULL AND damage_photos_json != '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_damage_photos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ai_repair_estimate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_repair_estimate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage6_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage6_complete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage5_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage5_complete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage4_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage4_complete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage3_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage3_complete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage2_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage2_complete,
  SUM(CASE WHEN stage1_complete = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stage1_complete
FROM ai_assessments;
